llm.summary: The skill appears to do what it says — it is an instruction-only wrapper around an HTTP email API using curl and three environment variables — with a small metadata mismatch to review and the expected sensitive token risk to consider.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (send/receive emails, wait for codes, download attachments) align with the declared requirements: curl plus MAILS_API_URL, MAILS_AUTH_TOKEN, MAILS_MAILBOX. One minor inconsistency: registry metadata lists no primary credential while the SKILL.md declares primaryEnv: MAILS_AUTH_TOKEN — this is likely a metadata sync issue but does not change functionality.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md contains concrete curl commands that only reference the declared env vars and the configured MAILS_API_URL endpoints. It does not instruct reading files or other system state, nor does it send data to unrelated external endpoints. It documents endpoints for inbox, email read/delete, code polling, attachments, and a no-auth /health endpoint.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — the skill is instruction-only, which minimizes on-disk risk. Required binary is only curl, which is reasonable for the provided curl examples.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Requested env vars (API URL, auth token, mailbox) are proportionate to the email API purpose. The MAILS_AUTH_TOKEN is sensitive (allows sending/receiving/deleting mail) and should be scoped, rotated, and limited to the mailbox. Also note the SKILL.md's primaryEnv differs from the registry-level 'Primary credential: none' — worth fixing so users understand which secret is primary.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not marked always:true and has no install-time persistence. It can be invoked autonomously by the agent (platform default) — this is normal but means the agent could call the email API without further user prompts unless you restrict autonomy.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is internally consistent: it only needs curl plus three environment values (MAILS_API_URL, MAILS_AUTH_TOKEN, MAILS_MAILBOX) to operate. Before installing: (1) confirm MAILS_API_URL points to a trusted service and not a personal/unknown host, (2) treat MAILS_AUTH_TOKEN as highly sensitive — give it least privilege and rotate it regularly, (3) be aware the agent (by default) can call the API autonomously — if you don't want unattended sending/receiving of email, disable autonomous invocation or require user approval before use, and (4) fix the small metadata mismatch (registry primary credential vs SKILL.md primaryEnv) so the UI clearly shows which secret is required.
